metadata.author: quant-os
metadata.rationale: 2.0×ATR SL and 3.5×ATR TP on M15 bars with 6-bar (90 min) horizon. M5→M15 compression ratio is 3×; original M5 horizon=12 bars, scaled 12/3=4, conservative round-up to 6. SL/TP multipliers kept same as M5 (2.0/3.5) for primary barrier strategy line consistency. 1.75:1 RR.
metadata.design_notes: M15 variant for Survival barrier strategy. 6-bar horizon = 90min. Same SL/TP multipliers as M5 SUR contract; SUR line needs wider SL tolerance than micro line (1.5/2.5). M15 features already present in v9_institutional_40 schema (8 M15-specific features).
